summary: Formalized the system's architectural evolution by integrating PEP 487 registries, a Topological Knowledge Dependency Graph (TKDG), and a Learning Velocity (LV) framework, while simultaneously implementing deployment telemetry to track Change Failure Rate (CFR) and rollback events. These initiatives shift focus from task volume to high-signal architectural output, ensuring growth tracking is grounded in structural integrity, atomic knowledge acquisition, and systemic reliability.
key_learnings: PEP 487 and structural hashing provide robust defense against state-space ambiguity.
Formalizing prioritization via (Impact × Urgency) / Complexity reduces cognitive bias.
Representing knowledge as a DAG prevents cognitive overload by enforcing foundational mastery.
Cyclomatic Complexity and branch coverage provide a comprehensive diagnostic suite for real-time technical debt detection.
Rollback Frequency (RF) must be normalized against deployment velocity to serve as a meaningful health metric.
Telemetry must be treated as a first-class citizen to enable proactive reliability analysis and surgical system stability.
